4a.n: Accept soup (minor spelling error), potage. Any or no article accepted but other unexpected words will probably INV. Tolerate plural. Tolerate elle préparait une soupe. Refuse present tense

4b.a: (elle est) directrice d’une maison de retraite
4b.n: Accept la / une directrice. Missing d’ or de or substitution with pour, treat as minor error. Refuse il because it is confusing. Reference to organising an excursion INV

a: Les résidents avaient (tous) soixante-dix ans ou plus.
4c.n: Accept present tense. Accept ils avaient au moins 70 ans. Accept qu’ils avaient… certains must be plural unless used as an adjective. Must have reflexive pronoun for se sentaient. Refuse ils se sentaient isolés. isolés does not need to agree but must have acute accent

4d.n: Accept any reasonable preposition or none e.g. dans, avec. Accept bus. No verb required but if supplied must be past tense

4e.a: Elle a mis de la crème solaire.
4e.n: Refuse …crème soleil. Verb is required to answer the question (mis / appliqué etc.)

4f.a: Audrey (lui) a raconté (plein d’ / des) histoires drôles.
4f.n: Pronoun in brackets not required for the mark, but if attempted must be correct. Subject required with verb. Histoires needs to be plural but drôle does not need agreement. Past tense required

4g.n: Accept à / sur la plage as alternative answer. près des autres résidents HA but not an answer in its own right. Accept any reasonable preposition with the chairs. qu’elles avaient louées HA. Tolerate les as alternative to des but not missing article

4h.n: Accept ils dormaient (subject required). certains needs to be plural unless used as an adjective e.g. certains résidents

4i.n: Accept partout. Refuse dans tout le monde. dans not required, but if replaced by something unsuitable, such as derrière or sans etc., please refuse. qu’ INV. No verb required but if used must be past tense

4j.n: Accept la mère de Céline. Refuse son mère. Refuse la mère on its own. If candidates choose to write more than the basic answer, what they write needs to be correct (e.g. lui / le / la)

4k.n: Mention of how the residents were feeling INV. Missed agreement is minor grammar error. Refuse synonyms for satisfaite. se sentir not required, but if candidates use it, it must be past tense and have the reflexive pronoun

6a.n: Accept Antoine avait commencé à étudier le droit, but donc would INV. cependant INV

6b.n: y is required, or reference to droit / études. Tolerate absence of ne but not absence of pas. Accept il ne l’aimait pas. Refuse present tense. lui not required for the mark, but if candidates have written an incorrect alternative, please refuse. Plural needed for les cours. Refuse les cours étaient interminables, unless the candidate adds selon lui, pour lui etc.

6c.a: (quand / lorsqu’) il voyait les gens qui arrivaient à l’hôpital (chaque jour)
6c.n: Needs the idea of Antoine seeing the people arriving at the hospital. Reference to his office being near the hospital or his wife being a doctor or that he wanted to be a pharmacist are likely to be HA but are not answers in their own right. Other structures are likely to be acceptable, e.g. voir des gens… / en voyant des gens…

6d.n: Accept suitable paraphrases that carry the same meaning e.g. son père était contre (l’idée). Accept lack of ne. Refuse il ne voulait pas (ambiguous). Refuse sa père. Needs past tense

6e.n: Accept elle est un(e) médecin / docteur / c’est un(e) médecin. Refuse (un(e)) médecin tc. Refuse médecine. et elle a un bébé INV. Present tense required

a: pour gérer une / la période pendant laquelle Antoine ne travaillerait pas
6f.n: études needs to be plural (ok if adjective does not agree). Idea of new studies may be successfully expressed using d’autres. il faut payer… INV (wrong tense). Tolerate pour payer pour… bien sûr INV. Accept où / que / quand as alternative to pendant laquelle. The idea that the absence from work will be temporary / for a fixed period is required. Accept le temps. pour required, but only penalise the first time that it is missing

6g.n: Accept il s’occupe du bébé. car certains cours sont en ligne HA

6h.a: On peut passer quarante ans à travailler.
6h.n: Tolerate lift of entire sentence: (selon lui), on peut…toutes ces années. Reference to 40 years is needed

6i.a: (C’est un métier où) on peut aider les gens.
6i.n: Other impersonal terms are likely to work, e.g. tu peux / vous pouvez. Refuse il peut / pour aider les gens. ça c’est sûr INV
